name: ppgp
description: Portable continuity protocol for long-running coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent goal continuity for long-running coding-agent work
interface.longDescription: Use PPGP to preserve verified goal state, frozen decisions, blockers, evidence, and the next executable action across long sessions, context compaction, and agent handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Recover the current PPGP goal state and continue from the next executable action.
